Core Active Vocabulary (5 items):

doctor — a person who treats ill people. Example: I need a doctor.
hospital — a place where ill people are treated. Example: The taxi goes to the hospital.
emergency — an urgent dangerous situation. Example: It is an emergency.
medicine — something you take when you are ill. Example: Take this medicine and rest.
pain — a feeling that something hurts. Example: I have got a bad pain.
Essential Chunks & Functional Collocations:

• I need a doctor.
• It is an emergency.
• Where is the nearest hospital?
• I have got a bad pain.
• Call an ambulance!
